sentences.text:
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajesh Kumar
 For the Petitioner : Mr. Sabyasanchi, Adv.
 For the State : Mr. Gautam Rakesh, A.P.P.
 ....
05/22.03.2023
The applicant who is in custody since 26.07.2022 has approac Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Itkhori P.S. Case No.75/2022.
The applicant has been made accused for the offence under Section 376 of IPC and Sections 4 and 6 of the POCSO Act.
The applicant is an accused of committing rape upon a minor girl.

It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant(s) that complete set of F.I.R. alongwith its enclosure have been annexed with this bail application and there is no suppression on his/her part.
Innocence has been claimed and undertaking has been given for participation in the trial.
It has been submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that due to the money dispute, this applicant has been falsely implicated in this case.
Further, during evidence, the victim girl and her father have been examined and they have stated that no rape has been committed.
On above basis prayer for bail has been made.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant.
Considering the stage of the trial, I am not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail, at this stage.
Accordingly prayer for bail of the applicant stands rejected.
However, the court below is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same within six months from the date of receipt/production of copy of this order.

(Rajesh Kumar, J.) Shahid/
